Commentary.Commentary: Shikhar Dhawan is Murali Kartik's guest. He explains that he enjoyed his innings as he took calculative risk. States he respected the good balls and he stuck to the process.  Admits that sometimes hardwork does not get the reward but he was never disheartened. On the conversation with Rohit Sharma, Shikhar says they were not able to convert in the last few matches so they just wanted to take their time in. Hopes that his century and partnership with Rohit can see the side home. Reckons that the pitch is good to bat but getting 350+ will be difficult and the pressure will be on Australia. On being asked his favorite shot of his innings, Dhawan smiles and says the one which he came down the track and lofted over covers.

So the target is one short of 360. The wicket is a belter but there will be scoreboard pressure on the Australians along with the thoughts of leveling the series. They will have to bat really well to get to this. Will they level the series or will the Indians seal it here itself? Join us in a while to find out. For now, Murali Kartik is with a guest.

Not a lot to write for the Aussie bowlers. It was a difficult day for them. The wicket had nothing on offer but you can say, they were poor with their lines and lengths too. Cummins did not seem at his best today but still finished with a fifer. Jhye did take three but his economy was above 9. Zampa was economical but only had a wicket to his name.

The openers laid the foundation for a big score, Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan added 193 runs. The former was dismissed in the 90s but the latter went onto get a ton. Once he got to his hundred, he was smashing the ball at will. With him striking the ball so well and a lot of batting to come, India would have been eyeing the 400-run mark then. However, after his wicket no batsman could make use of the starts. Pant and Rahul both got off to starts but were dismissed at the wrong time for India. Some meaty blows though towards the end from Shankar saw them finish on 358.

Win the toss, elect to bat in an excellent batting conditions and make full use of it. That is exactly what India have done here. They have set the Aussies a massive target. They could have probably got more but they will be extremely pleased with where they are at the moment.

SIX! Oh, my word. The number 11 has smoked one into the stands. Doesn't matter if you have taken five wickets, Bumrah gives room and lofts this over long on for a biggie. Virat Kohli loves it and so does Bumrah. India finish with 358/9 after 50 overs.
Jasprit Bumrah is the last man in for India.

OUT! Five wickets for Pat Cummins. What an effort. Length ball over the stumps, Chahal stays inside and looks to block it with a straight bat. The ball lobs to Cummins who dives low and takes the catch. The umpire takes it up but the catch was clean as a whistle. Chahal walks back for nought.
Has Cummins got his 5th? The umpires have gone upstairs to check if the catch is clean. THE SOFT SIGNAL IS NOT OUT THIS TIME!
Kuldeep guides this past point to give his spin twin the strike.
Yuzvendra Chahal is the next batsman.

OUT! Another one bites the dust. Shankar is the man to depart but has played a handy cameo. Gives room to his length ball and looks to loft another one. Ends up dragging it towards mid-wicket where Maxwell settles under it and makes no mistake.
Wide. Down the leg side. Shankar covers his stumps and leaves it.
Good comeback ball from Pat. Rolls his fingers to this outside off. Shankar fails to put bat to ball.
SIX! Mighty blow! Length ball on the stumps, Shankar gets under it and lofts this over the mid on region. The ball goes over the ropes for a maximum. The 350 is up for the hosts.
Kuldeep Yadav walks in at number 9.

OUT! A very good catch that! However, the idea was right from Kumar but it did not come off. He expected the short ball from Richardson and was already on the back foot. He gets it and then tries to upper cut but hits it too close to the keeper. Carey stretches his right hand upwards and the ball sticks. Jhye ends with a wicket but he has been very expensive today. Gives away 13 in the penultimate over and his figures read 9-0-85-3.
On the shorter side, Shankar pulls it to fine leg for a run.
On the pads, Kumar does the right thing, he works it around the corner for a run.
BYE! Jhye follows him as he bowls it on the body. Shankar looks to go over mid on again but misses. The ball bounces just in front of the keeper who fumbles and concedes a run.
FOUR! 10 from the first two balls. This time it is slightly fuller on middle, Shankar lofts it over the mid on fielder and into the boundary.

SIX! Nails this one! That was all power! It was the slower short ball and on middle, Shankar makes room and flat-bats it over the bowler's head for a biggie. India would love a big over here and they have started off well.
The next batsman in is Bhuvneshwar Kumar.

OUT! In the process of getting big runs, Kedar Jadhav too holes out. Length ball on off, Jadhav shuffles across and looks to flick it off his pads. Gets connection on it but finds Jhye Richardson at deep square leg. India are losing wickets in clusters now. Good comeback from the Aussies.
Still not getting the boundaries. Lifts this above the cover-point region to get to the other end.
Helped away fine to deep fine leg for one more.
20 balls now without a boundary. Vijay flicks this too well to the man at square leg which forces him to take just one.
Length ball at 140 kph. Kedar steps out and pushes it towards mid on for one.
Length ball on off, Shankar lofts it above cover-point for a single.
Driven nicely towards mid on. The fielder there stops it with a dive. A run is taken. 9 from the over without any risk taken.
On the shorter side, Jadhav pulls it through square leg for just a run.
Goes full now and this one comes back in. Shankar looks to put bat on ball but gets an inside edge onto it. An appeal follows but the umpire immediately indicates that there is bat.
Continues bowling the slower short ball. Shankar goes for the pull but it goes off the inner half towards deep square leg for a single.
Another wide! Slower ball and down the leg side. Shankar looks to pull but misses.
Short and on middle, Jadhav goes back and pulls it to square leg for a single.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side, the batsman lets it be and it has been wided.
Slower ball on middle, the batter works it around the corner for a run.
Jhye Richardson is back on for what should be his final spell.
A dot to end a very good over by Cummins. 4 runs and a wicket from it. Length ball on off, Jadhav blocks it out.
Takes a few steps ahead and then works it with soft hands through mid-wicket. They take one and then go for the second. Complete it. Very good running.
Width on offer outside off, Shankar guides it through backward point and takes a single.
The next batsman in is Vijay Shankar.

OUT! Pant is out of here and now India have half the side back in the hut! Once again it is the slower one and Pant is done in by the pace. He looks to clear mid on but it goes off the inner half and it just about carries to Finch there. They check for the no ball but Cummins is fine. End of Pant's cameo. India though would have liked for him to stay out longer.
The slower ball on off, Pant does not get the desired timing as he hits it to mid on.
Good length and outside off, KJ guides it down to third man and gives the strike Pant.
Pat Cummins is back into the attack.

A single to end a good over for India. Jadhav strokes it down to long on for a run. 12 from Zampa's last and he finishes with figures of 10-0-57-1. Quite decent when the opposition is going at more than 6 per over.
This is bowled wide outside off, Pant slaps it down to long off for a run. Smart bowling, Zampa fires it wide looking to stay away from Pant's zone.
Walks down the track and Zampa fires it outside off. Pant pushes it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Short and it has been put away! Short and down the leg side, Pant pulls it through backward square leg. The fielder in the deep runs to his left and tries to stop it but fails to do so. 10 from 3 balls. This could be another huge over here.
Now goes for the reverse sweep but the ball is very full on the pads. He misses and gets hit on the pads.

SIX! All the way! Straight as an arrow! Dances down the track and gets to the pitch of it. Pant smashes it over the bowler's head and it goes over the fence. A biggie to start the over, pressure on the bowler now.
Played to mid-wicket region by Pant. The batsmen have run through for a single.
300 up for India. Jadhav taps this to mid on for one.
The batsman guides it to third man very late. One run added to the total.
Moves this on the gap through mid-wicket for a single. Jadhav gets his scoreboard ticking.
On middle and leg, tucked away to the on side.
Fuller ball on the stumps, Pant comes down and hoicks this to cow corner for one.
Kedar Jadhav is the new man in. Also, Glenn Maxwell is back into the attack.

OUT! And it has got even better as Zampa strikes on the last ball. Australia continue to pick wickets at regular intervals here. The slider outside off, Rahul goes back and looks to be cheeky. He tries to guide it late through short third man but gets a feather on it to Carey. He takes it and appeals. Rahul holds his ground but the umpire raises his finger. Rahul fails to make use of the excellent batting surface here as he falls after getting a start. He is very disappointed with himself and rightly so.
On the shorter side, Pant plays it through mid-wicket for a single. This has been a good over so far.
Good fielding! Saw Rahul come down the track and bowls it short, it is also the googly. Rahul works it through wide mid on for a run.
Another googly, Pant again mistimes his shot through covers for a single.
The googly on off, Pant goes back and mistimes it to covers.
Uses his feet and nicely strokes it wide of long off but only for a run.
Adam Zampa is back into the attack.
Another low full toss to end the over. Rahul eases it down to long on for a run. 16 from the over and 25 from the last two. Powerplay 3 has begun in great fashion for the hosts.
Just a single now as this is hit down to long off for a single.

FOUR! This one is edgy but Pant won't care! Full and wide outside off, Pant looks to jam it out but it goes off the outside edge. Past the diving keeper and into the fence. 14 now with a couple of balls to go.
FOUR! This time through the leg side! On the fuller side and on middle, Pant flicks it through mid-wicket. It is in the gap and a boundary results. 10 from the first three balls.
From over the wicket now, he bowls it on the pads. Pant works it through square leg and takes two.
FOUR! That had class written all over it! A half volley but it still had to be hit well. Pant does exactly that as he strokes it through covers and into the fence. Ideal start to the over.

FOUR! A dangerous shot from Rahul but gets the desired result. Fuller on middle, Rahul premeditates his sweep and connects it towards the fine leg region for a boundary. Had he missed that he would have been plumb in front.
Shorter on off, Pant punches it to cover for a run.
Good running! Loopy delivery on middle, Pant flicks it wide of mid-wicket and gets a brace.
Flighted on middle and leg, Rahul steers it to mid on and takes a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Pant tucks it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.
Flighted on middle, Pant blocks it off his front foot.
Powerplay 3 signalled by the umpire. Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle till the end of the innings. Glenn Maxwell to roll his arm over.
Pant keeps strike as he works it through mid-wicket for a single. Just the two runs and a wicket from this over.
Back of a length around off, Pant pushes it to point.
Rishabh Pant walks in at number 5. Replaces his skipper out in the middle.

OUT! That has carried! Stunned silence here as Virat Kohli, the Indian skipper, does not contribute a lot. Two wickets in quick succession for Australia. That is the only way they can stem the run flow here. Jhye gets his first as he bowls it full and very wide outside off. Kohli reaches out for it but it seems to have taken the edge and goes low towards Carey who takes it and appeals. The umpire is not sure so he walks to the square leg umpire. They both have a chat and then take it upstairs. The SOFT SIGNAL IS OUT! Replays confirm that it is a legal catch.
Have Australia got another? They have gone upstairs to check if the ball has carried to the keeper or not. The SOFT SIGNAL IS OUT!
Fullish and outside off, Kohli goes after it away from his body but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
Length and outside off, Rahul opens the face at the very end and guides it down to third man for a single.
On the shorter side outside off, Rahul cuts it to point.
Jhye Richardson is back.

FOUR! A very unusual shot this from Kohli. He continues from where he left off in the last innings. Full length delivery on off, Virat moves across the line and paddles it towards the vacant fine leg region for a boundary. You very rarely see him play such an unorthodox shot.
Good length ball on off, KL pushes it with straight bat towards deep cover for a single.
Good length ball around off, Kohli punches it powerfully straight to the fielder at deep cover for a single.
Length ball on the fourth stump line, Rahul defends it towards point with soft hands and gets to the other end.
Length ball on middle, Rahul blocks it.
Good length delivery on middle, Rahul tucks it towards backward square leg with soft hands and looks for two. Both these batsmen are quick between the wickets and they easily get it.
On the pads again, Kohli works it on the leg side and takes two. End of a successful over for Australia.
A little too straight, Kohli works it towards mid-wicket. Right off the middle there.
Indian skipper, Virat Kohli walks in at number 4 to a huge cheer from the crowd.

OUT! TIMBER! The change of angle does the trick for Cummins. Dhawan who was looking to hit everything, departs in an attempt to do so again. Pat from around the wicket angles it into the middle pole. Dhawan swings across the line but the length was not quite the one to hit. He misses and it hits the top of middle. He walks back to a standing ovation and deserves every bit of it.
Down the leg side, Dhawan swings but misses. It has been wided.
On the body and it is shorter in length. Dhawan looks to pull but it goes off his glove. Carey behind makes a good stop diving to his right.

FOUR! Hammered! Just where can you bowl to this guy at the moment? Short, he will hit you, full, he will hit you. Cummins tries length and he is smashed through extra cover for a boundary. 250 up for India.
Length ball on off, Rahul once again does the smart thing as he gives the strike to Dhawan by pushing it through covers.

FOUR! 15 from the over! Dhawan is playing a different game. Stays on middle and whips this over the inner mid-wicket ring for a boundary. The fielder gets to the ball but couldn't manage to keep it out. Behrendorff finishes with the figures of 10-1-61-0.
SIX! He is batting the way he wants. Makes room, gets low and slaps this uppishly over the bowler's head for half a dozen.

FOUR! That's the reason you give him the strike. He is in the mood today. Overpitched on middle, Dhawan uses his bottom hand and flicks this uppishly through mid-wicket. Reminded many of Jayasuriya here in the cubical.
That's better. Gives the strike to the man in form. Guides it to third man and changes end.
Full again just drifting down leg, Rahul turns it to the leg side.
Fuller ball right on the money. Rahul does well to get bat to it.
Jason Behrendorff is back on.

FOUR! Poor bowling this! They are bowling it on the body of Dhawan and it is easy pickings for him. He just goes back and pulls it all along the ground to the backward square leg fence. 11 from this over.
Dhawan is looking to hit every ball here! He swings to a delivery outside off, mistimes it back to the bowler.
Walks right across and then works it towards square leg. Calls for two early and completes it.
Good length on off, Dhawan defends it onto the ground.
FOUR! That has raced to the fence! Short and on the body, Dhawan picks the length early and then pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length on middle, Rahul works it across the line and gets to the other end.

Drinks - India are on top here. But Australia would be happy that they have at least got rid of Rohit Sharma. Shikhar Dhawan though is looking dangerous and he is joined by KL Rahul out in the middle. India will hope these two can build another solid partnership, whereas, Australia will look to pick up quick wickets, which they have to if they want to restrict India under 320. Also, Pat Cummins to bowl after the Drinks break.
KL on-drives this through mid on and will retain strike for the next one. 13 from this over.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! And follows the six with a boundary. Picks the length up early and reverse this fine from the short fine leg fielder. Once he beat him the ball has no competition.
SIX! Amazing! Tossed up on off, Dhawan charges out and nonchalantly lofts this over long off. He goes through with the shot and has enough to sail to the fence.
Works this fine through square leg to give his partner the strike.
Cheeky. Rahul reverse sweeps this to the man at 45. Rahul wants the run but Dhawan denies it.
Superb fielding! Dhawan brings the sweep shot out, he hits it to the right of Jason who dives and stops it. Dhawan wants a run but is sent back.
Dances down the track and with soft hands pushes it through cover for a single.
The slider on middle, Rahul goes back and flicks it to mid-wicket. Two dots in a row.
On the stumps, it is worked to mid-wicket.
Dances down the track but the ball is too full, he jams it past the bowler for a single.
A low full toss on middle, Rahul at the very end uses his wrists and hits it through covers for a run.
Wide outside off, Dhawan hits it but straight to short cover.
On the stumps, Rahul eases it down to long on and gets to the other end.
Nicely played! He goes back and then guides it through point for a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.
Tosses it up on off, Dhawan strokes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Flatter and on off, Rahul pushes it down to long on and takes a single.
Change in bowling. Glenn Maxwell replaces Jhye Richardson.

FOUR! 16th ODI 100 for Shikhar Dhawan! What a time to get it and he has silenced his critics. Leg spinner on the leg side, Dhawan controls his flick through square leg and the ball races to the fence. Takes his helmet out and brings out a broad smile. Well deserved.
Steps out and drives this to long on for another run.
Dhawan turns it away through mid-wicket to give Rahul the strike back.
Around off this time, the leg spinner. Rahul taps it towards covers for one to get off the mark.
On the pads, Rahul turns it away to the on side.
Dhawan goes back and pushes the ball through covers for a single.
KL Rahul is the new man in at number 3. Also, Adam Zampa replaces his skipper.

OUT! In the air... taken! Rohit Sharma departs in the nervous 90s and Australia will be relieved that they got a wicket at last. End of a mammoth 193-run stand. The short ball does the trick. It is on middle and Rohit goes for the pull. He hits it nicely but hits it flat and straight to the fielder at deep square leg, Handscomb there takes it nicely. Rohit is disappointed as he punches his bat in disgust. Nevertheless, a very good innings by him comes to an end. Deserved a ton but his partnership with Dhawan has laid the foundation for a big score here. Can India capitalize or will Australia now crawl back?
FOUR! SHOT! Rohit at it again. Short ball on the leg side, Sharma stays inside the line and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Punched off the back foot by Dhawan. They pick up a single.
FOUR! The boundaries are coming fast here. Short ball down the leg side. Dhawan hook it but is not in total control off it. The ball still runs away fine to the fine leg fence.
Good fielding but some lazy running. Fuller ball on the pads again, Dhawan whips it away towards deep square leg. The fielder there dives but the batsmen take just two.
On the pads, flicked away through square leg for one.
The Indians are now trying to open up knowing that it is a very good pitch to bat on.

FOUR! Poor ball and it has been put away! This time he pulls it away from the short fine leg fielder. Too far for Marsh to make an effort and the over ends with a boundary. Also, this probably will be Finch's last over.
Rohit gets down on one knee, keeps his eyes on the ball and hits it through square leg for a couple. He had to put bat on ball there or he would have been a goner.
Fires it outside off, Dhawan looks to go big but mistimes it to long off for a single.
On the shorter side again, Rohit goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.

Finds the gap nicely! It is slightly short and outside off, Rohit goes back and guides it through point and backward point. The fielder in the latter position runs after it and pulls it back in. Rohit wanted a third but Dhawan refuses. Not happy is Rohit there.
Flatter and on middle, Dhawan pushes it down to long off for a run.
Length again, Rohit once again gets it away from the sweeper cover fielder, not for a boundary but for a couple. 10 from the over and 17 from the last two.
Back of a length on off, Dhawan goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
On the shorter side and on the body, Rohit pulls it towards fine leg and gets to the other end.
FOUR! After a few quiet overs, India getting into the groove again. Full and on off, Rohit strokes it through covers and it races to the fence.
Excellent fielding! On the shorter side outside off, Rohit cuts it through point. Marsh in the deep runs to his left and just before the ball crosses the ropes, pushes it back in. Two taken.
Fuller in length on off, Rohit strokes it to mid off.
Jhye Richardson is back.
Uses his feet but mistimes his shot to long on for a run.
This is pushed through covers for a run.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Bowls it a touch quicker now, the ball is stroked back to the bowler.
FOUR! On the pads and it is very slow. Rohit goes down on one knee and then sweeps it to the square leg boundary.
Gives it nice air and lands it around middle, it is blocked out.
It does not though as Dhawan finds the man at covers with his drive. A couple of tight overs here for Australia.
Angles this on the pads, Rohit flicks it to fine leg and jogs to the other end. This is turning out to be another good over but the last ball can spoil it.
Well fielded! Saves at least two there. Full and outside off, Rohit drives it square on the off side. The fielder at point dives and makes a good stop.
From around the wicket, this is angled into the batsman. Rohit works it towards mid-wicket.
On the shorter side and width on offer outside off. Dhawan slaps it hard through covers but close to the sweeper for a single.
Once again gets this one to tail back in a little, Dhawan pushes it back to the bowler.
Another very slow delivery on off, Rohit goes back and punches it to covers. Just 4 from Finch's first.
Very slow and on middle, Dhawan with soft hands works it towards mid-wicket for an easy single.
Flatter and on the shorter side, the batter goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
This one stays a touch low after pitching on off, Rohit pushes it back to the bowler.
Dhawan now plays it with the turn through mid-wicket for a run. 150 up for India. The 6th time the duo has managed to get there.
Gives it nice air and lands it around off, Rohit with the turn hits it through covers for a run.
The skipper has introduced himself into the attack now.
Back of a length on middle, Rohit works it on the leg side and gets to the other end. Just a couple from this over, a good one.
Goes short but too easy at JB's pace. Dhawan goes back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Well bowled! Signs of some reverse swing there. This one comes back in from off. Dhawan looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A little short and outside off, that seems to have come slow off the surface. Dhawan throws his bat at it but it goes off the inner half back to the bowler.
Back of a length on off, Dhawan stands tall and pushes it to mid on.
This one tails back in a little from outside off, Dhawan strokes it to mid off.
Just a single from the last two balls but still 10 from the over. Dhawan this time gets bat to it, hits it through mid-wicket for a run.
This is fired on the pads, Dhawan looks to work it on the leg side but misses. An appeal follows but the umpire shakes his head.
Now strokes it down to long off and gets to the other end. 9 from the over already.
SIX! Easy-peasy! Short and on middle, it just skids on. Rohit goes back and pulls it with aplomb over the mid-wicket fence.
Good batting! Rohit uses his feet but Zampa tries to outsmart him by bowling it quicker and outside off. Rohit though is smarter as he adjusts and then guides it through point for a couple.
Tosses it up on middle, Rohit blocks it out.
Length ball pitching on middle and leg. The ball goes with the angle, Dhawan looks to stroke it on the off side but gets hit on the thigh pad outside leg stump line.
Outside off this, Sharma gives Dhawan the strike by running it down to third man.
Full again on off, Rohit glances it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Fuller on middle and off, Shikhar steers it to long on and gets to the other end.
Bowls it outside off on a length, Sharma guides it towards third man and rotates the strike.
Good length delivery outside off, Dhawan cuts it late towards third man for a single.
Change in bowling. Jason Behrendorff is back into the attack.
Another single to end! So six singles in this over as Dhawan works it around the corner for a run.

Rohit Sharma brings up his 50 off 61 balls. He has been made to work harder for his runs than his partner. He gets there with a gentle drive through the cover region. He too will be eyeing a big score here.
Another tossed up ball on off, Dhawan leans into the stroke and hits it down to long off. Changes strike.
A low full toss on the pads, Rohit strokes it to long on and gets to the other end.
The leg spinner on middle, Dhawan once again picks it, he goes back and punches it to long on for a run.
The slider on the pads, Rohit goes back and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
A single to end an expensive over! 10 from it. Rohit guides it towards point and gets to the other end.
Dhawan lunges out and eases it down to long off for a run.
On the shorter side and outside off, Rohit slaps it through covers for a single.
This is fired outside off, SD goes back and guides it through point for a run.
Dhawan there first thinks of sweeping it but then seeing the length does not. He adjusts and works it towards mid-wicket.
SIX! Easy pickings! Short and on middle, Dhawan has all the time in the world to rock back and pull it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Dances down the track but it is the quicker one. Rohit hits it hard towards the bowler who gets a hand and stops the run.
The yorker on leg pole, Rohit manages to get his bat down in time and jam it out.
The googly, Dhawan picks it and with the turn he pushes it through cover for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Uses his feet but Zampa shortens the length, SD pushes it down to long on for a run.
On the stumps, it is worked to the left of the bowler who moves swiftly and stops it.
This is very full on off, it is stroked down to long off for a run. An expensive return for Maxwell.
FOUR! Short and it has been put away! A drag down on middle, Dhawan goes back and pulls it all along the ground for a boundary.
Gives it a lot more air on middle, Dhawan strokes it back to the bowler.
This is angled into the batsman, Dhawan works it to mid-wicket.
Flighted ball on off, Dhawan strokes it to the right of the bowler. The fielder from covers runs to his left and saves a run.

Well fielded! This is slightly short and going away with the angle. Rohit goes back, waits for it and then guides it through point. Jhye Richardson in the deep makes a lot of ground to his left and manages to push the ball back in play. Saves a run for his side.

DRINKS! India going along really well. The two openers are well-set now, the run rate is also excellent and the foundation for a big score has been laid. Australia will need a couple of quick wickets if they are to get back into the game. Glenn Maxwell to bowl after Drinks.
Good length ball outside off, Sharma punches it to deep cover and keeps the strike.
Fuller on middle and leg, Rohit hits it straight to mid on.
Length delivery on off, Sharma pushes it to the fielder at point.
On the pads, Dhawan  looks to flick it but gets hit on the pads. The ball goes to the leg side and a leg bye is stolen.
Wide. Cummins misses the mark with this bouncer. He sends it down to leg side. Dhawan looks to hook it but misses. Wide signalled.
100 comes up for India. They have got off to an excellent start here. Good length delivery on off, Rohit hits it to point and gets a single. 15th ODI century partnership between these two.
Slightly fuller around off, Sharma looks to hit it on the off side but gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
A dot to end as Dhawan pushes it towards cover! A good passage of play building here for the visitors. Just 11 from the last 3.
On the shorter side on middle, this is stroked down to long on for a single.
On the pads again, this is worked around the corner for a run.
Eased through mid on for a single.
Gives it a nice loop and lands it on off. Rohit tries to defend with an angled but gets it off the inner half towards the bowler.
Extremely full on middle, Dhawan jams it out towards mid on for a single.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. It is blocked. Back-to-back tight overs by Australia. They need to keep doing this if they are to build pressure here.
On the off pole, it is kept out.
Back of a length on off, Rohit pushes it to covers.
A little too straight, Dhawan works it around the corner for a run.
On the shorter side, Rohit goes back and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for a run.
Pat Cummins is in for another burst.

The slider to end with! It is on the pads, Rohit looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. Another decent over by Zampa. He is keeping it nice and tight but needs support from the other end too.
Stays low! On the shorter side, Rohit goes back and looks to cut but the ball sneaks under his bat.
On the pads, Dhawan goes back and pushes it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and on middle, Dhawan goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
A half-tracker! Dhawan fails to take full toll of it as he goes back and pulls it hard but straight to the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Only a run.
Tosses it up around off, Rohit leans into it and strokes it through covers for a run.
A dot to end! Dhawan defends it off the back foot. Another productive over for the hosts.
This is angled on the pads, Dhawan flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
A good short ball! This is also well-directed. Dhawan plays it really well as he hops and keeps it down.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
On the shorter side but it is not high enough to trouble the batsman. Dhawan goes back and pulls it all along the ground towards deep square leg for a run.

FOUR! Fifty for Dhawan! A much-needed one for him. He was struggling for runs but he has looked very fluent in this innings. His 28th in ODIs. He though looks good for a big one here and he would be eager to make it big. He gets there with an immaculate straight drive past the bowler. No need to run for those. He gets a bear hug from Rohit Sharma and a round of applause from the crowd here.
On the off pole, Dhawan drops it towards point and completes a run. Excellent start by Zampa, good lines and lengths by him.
The googly on middle, Dhawan guides it towards point.
Flatter and on middle, Dhawan pushes it back to the bowler.
Very full again, Rohit strokes it down to long on and takes another single.
A little too full this time, the batter eases it down to long on and gets to the other end.
The leg spinner to begin with, Dhawan works it towards square leg.
Adam Zampa is on now.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Richardson to end the over. Length ball on the pads, Sharma flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Full length delivery, Shikhar hits it wide of mid off and takes a quick single.
Bouncer. Surprises Dhawan with this. Shikhar sways away from it.
Length ball on middle, Sharma tucks it to leg side and gets to the other end.
Length ball on off, Dhawan hits it towards cover for a single.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Sharma flicks it wide of mid-wicket for a single
Jhye Richardson is back on.

Misfield and three conceded! Goes fuller and outside off, Sharma drives it square on the off side. Khawaja at point dives over the ball. Another fielder though hares behind the ball and pushes it back in before it crosses the ropes. Three taken, Maxwell's second is an expensive one.
Too full on middle, this is eased down to long off for a run.
Goes back to bowling a straighter line, this is worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and the length is much better on this one. The batsman blocks it out.
Now it is off the front foot, through covers, not for a boundary but a couple.
FOUR! Poor ball and put away! Short and width on offer. With the field up on the off side, Rohit slaps it through covers, it is in the gap and a boundary.
Power play 2 signalled by the umpire. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.

A single to end Powerplay 1 as Sharma flicks it through square leg. An excellent first 10 for the hosts. They would the openers continue. It seems like a belter and they would hope the two can lay the foundation for a big score.
This is angled into the pads, Dhawan works it with the angle towards square leg for a run.
Sensible batting! Got a maximum, now he need not take a risk. Just opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
Drags his length back a little, Sharma works it towards mid-wicket.

SIX! Takes the aerial route and clears the fence! The pressure which was built in the last over has been eased off with this brilliant shot. It is just ahead of a length and on off. Rohit extends his arms and lofts it over the long on fence. 50 up for India, excellent start for them.
Attacks the off pole, Dhawan stands tall and punches it towards wide mid off for a single.
He does, excellent start by Maxwell. It is on the stumps again. Rohit Sharma blocks it out.
Continues bowling the straighter line, Sharma works it with the little turn available to mid-wicket. 5 dots in a row, can he bowl a maiden?
Similar line to the last ball and Rohit plays a similar shot to the same fielder.
Another one on the pads, Rohit plays it with a straight bat to mid on.
This is slower through the air and on the stumps, Rohit pushes it back to the bowler.
Starts off with a flatter delivery and it is angled outside off, Rohit goes back and slaps it to cover-point.
Glenn Maxwell is on now.

FOUR! This time Dhawan goes leg side. Length delivery on middle and leg, Shikhar flicks it uppishly wide of the short mid-wicket fielder for a boundary. No chance stopping that. Dhawan is timing it beautifully today. 10 runs off the over.

FOUR! Excellent shot. Good length delivery on off, Dhawan waits for the ball to come and then slaps it through cover for a boundary. Nothing wrong with the delivery but Shikhar looks in the mood today.
Beautiful shot for no run. Length ball on off, Dhawan drives it beautifully but straight to the fielder at mid off.
On the stumps this one, Shikhar blocks it away.
Length delivery on off, Sharma drives it beautifully towards cover. Khawaja there dives to his left and stops a certain boundary. Can't stop the single though.
Good length delivery on middle and leg, Shikhar flicks it towards square leg and gets a single.
FOUR! Elegant! Full length delivery on off, Sharma gets on his front foot and drives it through covers for his first boundary of the day.
On the pads, Rohit flicks it straight to the fielder at square leg.
Good length delivery on off, Dhawan rotates the strike by hitting it wide of mid off.
Play and a miss. Length delivery outside off, Dhawan looks to hit it on the off side but gets beaten.
FOUR! Wow. Short and wide from Richardson and Dhawan punishes it. Back of a length delivery outside off, Dhawan cuts it through point for a boundary.
Dhawan rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball on the off side.
Beautiful shot and excellent fielding. Length ball on off, Dhawan punches it towards cover. Marsh there dives to his left and stops it. He does not hold onto it cleanly so a single is taken.
Smart batting this. Follows the boundary with a calm defense. Good length ball on off, Dhawan blocks it.
FOUR! Jeez! Dhawan looks in great touch today. Back of a length delivery around off, Dhawan gets on his back foot and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Rotates strike which is good. Works this on the on side to get to the other end.
This one is closer to the off pole. Rohit shows his solid front foot defense.
Back of a length ball just outside off, Rohit pushes it towards cover-point.
Back of a length delivery, Dhawan gets behind the ball and blocks it to see off the over. Good over for India. 10 runs off it.
Length ball on off. Dhawan once again follows the boundary with a dot by pushing it to cover.
FOUR! Dhawan is looking good today. Length ball on middle and leg, Shikhar flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away to the fence.
Dot now. Good length delivery on off, Shikhar pushes it to point.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. The best shot in cricket? Overpitched delivery on middle and off, Dhawan waits for it and drives it along the turf straight back the bowler. What a sight.
Good running. Good length delivery outside off, Dhawan times his back foot punch beautifully wide of cover. Sharma calls for two straight away and runs quickly to come back to the bowler's end.
Dot to finish the over. Length ball on middle and leg. Sharma looks to flick but gets hit high on the thigh pad.
Good length delivery on the fourth stump line, Sharma looks to poke at it but misses and it goes to the keeper.

After 10 deliveries a run is scored off Behrendorff. It is not in the most convincing way. Good length ball on middle and leg, Dhawan looks to hit it to the off side but gets an inside edge and it goes towards fine leg for a single.
Length delivery on off, Shikhar looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Good length delivery on middle and off, Dhawan tucks it to the fielder at square leg.
Full on middle and leg, Dhawan looks to flick but it goes off his pad to square leg. It was going down the leg side hence no appeal for lbw.
Good length delivery on off, Sharma blocks it to see off the over.
Full length delivery around off, Rohit confidently hits it to the fielder at mid off.
Length ball on the pads. Sharma misses his flick and gets hit on the thigh pad.
Smart cricket. On off, Dhawan taps it with soft hands towards covers and takes a quick single.

FOUR! Nicely played! Good ball to begin with. Full and on the stumps, Dhawan just flicks it through the gap at the mid-wicket region. Finch thinks of chasing it but then leaves it alone. Good cricket all-round.
Length ball around the off pole, Rohit opens the bat face and helps it to deep backward point for one.
Fourth stump line again. Dhawan blocks his off stump and the ball goes past him. Behrendorff starts with a maiden.

So close!  Full length delivery outside off, Dhawan looks to defend it but it flicks off his pads and goes to Carey. The keeper and bowler go up in appeal but the umpire turns it down. There was no bat involved and the ball would have gone to miss the top of off as Hawk Eye suggests.
Full again on middle and leg, Shikhar pushes it to the fielder at mid on.
Full on off, Dhawan hits it to the fielder at short mid-wicket.
On the fifth stump line. Dhawan shoulders arms to it.
Starts with a good ball. Length delivery on the fourth stump line. Behrendorff gets a hint of away swing. Dhawan keeps his bat on his off stump and it goes past him to the keeper.
Jason Behrendorff to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Dot to finish the over. On a length around off, Sharma hits it straight to the fielder at mid off. 6 runs off the first over.
Full again to Sharma. This is on middle stump. Rohit taps it back to the bowler.
Follows that up with a single. Length ball on off, Shikhar pushes it wide of the cover fielder and gets a run.

FOUR! Shikhar Dhawan is up and running. Cummins misses his line and bowls a length delivery on the pads. Dhawan flicks it away towards the square leg fence for a boundary. Nice way to get off the mark.
Once again full, this time on middle and leg. Sharma drives it to mid on and takes a single. Richardson there dives to his left and keeps it down to one. First runs off the day.
Cummins comes steaming in and bowls full length delivery on off. It is right on the money. Cummins gets a hint of away swing. Sharma does well to block it.
We are all set to begin. Out walk Indian opening pair of Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan. The former will take the strike. Pat Cummins to start proceedings with the first new ball for Australia.

Aaron Finch, the Australian captain says that he would have batted first as well. Says the pitch will remain same and hopes that they bowl well and take early wickets. States that they want to level the series and wants to look at the bigger picture going forward.

Virat Kohli, the Indian captain says he wants to bat first. Reckons it looks like a belter of a pitch and he wants to put runs on the board. Adds saying Australia want to level the series so there will be pressure to chase it down. Feels the pitch will remain the same and states he cannot predict if there will be due or not. Mentions there are 4 changes in the squad. Dhoni, Rayudu, Shami and Jadeja are out Pant, Rahul, Bhuvneshwar and Chahal are in.
TOSS - Finch calls heads but tails it is. India win the toss and elect to bat first.

PITCH REPORT - Murali Kartik and Sunil Gavaskar are down for the pitch report. The latter reckons it looks like a good surface with a hint of grass covering. Feels that the pitch will help seamers at the start. Adds there will be no assistance for spinners and the pitch will be a good one for batting. Expects another 600-run game. Feels that India had a bad experience bowling first in Ranchi. Opines that if the sky is clear later in the day then there will be dew. Still feels that the captain winning the toss should bowl first

Hello and welcome to the crucial 4th ODI of this 5-match ODI series between India and Australia. The visitors showed promise in the first 2 ODIs and were finally able to get over the line in the 3rd one. One would feel the momentum is with the Aussies but this Indian side has shown it in the past that they bounce back stronger when they are down. The Men in Blue will like to prove that the loss in the 3rd ODI was just a hiccup and nothing more. The Kangaroos will look to draw the series level here in Mohali, whereas  India will look to wrap it up. An exciting clash awaits us. Stay tuned for further updates...
